title: Chemical short-range order increases the phonon heat conductivity in a refractory high-entropy alloy

recollection.mechanism: Enhanced phonon scattering reduction due to ordered atomic arrangements
recollection.results: Increased phonon heat conductivity compared to a disordered state

score.note: The recollection correctly identifies introducing chemical short-range order and a reduction in phonon scattering, but it lacks the specific HfTi/TiZr clusters, B2-like ordering, percolation pathways, reduced lattice distortion, and phonon-DOS changes. It reports only a qualitative conductivity increase and omits the ~12% magnitude.
